what: A six-page invented briefing given as a chunk file of four pages (1-3, 5) and the full text. The key term 'industry-linked delegate' is defined only in the annex on page 6, which is not in the chunk file, so the reader must search the full text for it. No year, no authors, no claim of peer review.

checks.quotes_exact: every quote is in the full text, word for word
checks.quote_pages_right: every quote is on the page the record gives
checks.definition_from_full_text: the definition of 'industry-linked delegate' is recorded with a quote from page 6, found by searching the full text
checks.finding_number: the finding of 412 industry-linked delegates is recorded
checks.proxy_found: the marine fuel licence in the company register is recorded as a proxy
checks.pages_read_copies_note: pages_read contains the chunk file's coverage note
checks.pages_read_adds_search: pages_read names page 6 as searched for
checks.no_whole_reading_claimed: pages_read does not say the whole source was read
